sourceChecks.text: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ノブの祭司アヒメレクがダビデを迎える。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Ahimelech the priest, “The king has commanded me to do something, and has said to me, ‘Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you, and what I have commanded you. I have sent the young men to a certain place.’
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデがアヒメレクに王の命令を口実として告げる。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Ahimelech, “Isn’t there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven’t brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデがアヒメレクに武器を求める。

sourceChecks.text: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ドエグがノブでアヒメレクに会うダビデを見たと報告する。

sourceChecks.text: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: サウルがアヒメレクを呼び、本文はアヒトブの子と明記する。

sourceChecks.text: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, captain of your body guard, and honored in your house?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アヒメレクがダビデの忠実さをサウルに答える。

sourceChecks.text: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: サウルがアヒメレクとその家族に死を宣告する。

sourceChecks.text: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がアヒメレクの子アビヤタルの逃亡を記す。

sourceChecks.text: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アビヤタルをアヒメレクの子と呼び、エフォドを携えてダビデのもとに来たと記す。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデが祭司アビヤタルをアヒメレクの子と呼ぶ。

wikipediaArticleRead.title: Ahimelech
wikipediaArticleRead.noteJa: 記事はノブの祭司アヒメレクを扱い、サウルから逃れていたダビデがノブで彼を訪ねた場面を説明しています。
wikipediaArticleRead.verifiedHeadingOrText: 記事冒頭はアヒメレクをノブのイスラエル人祭司とし、Relation to David節が1 Samuel 21:1–9のノブでの面会と22:9–23の召喚・処刑を説明。
